methods.description: Return transaction traces in transaction-index order, each in preorder. Historical PoW block and uncle rewards follow transaction records. Do not emit synthetic zero PoW rewards after the Merge; withdrawals are outside this call-trace profile. Unknown blocks and unavailable history are errors (H05,H27). This is a provisional trace profile; see docs-api/docs/trace-profile.md and its H01-H28 decision references.

methods.name: trace_block

oneOf.description: `earliest`: The lowest numbered block the client has available; `finalized`: The most recent crypto-economically secure block, cannot be re-orged outside of manual intervention driven by community coordination; `safe`: The most recent block that is safe from re-orgs under honest majority and certain synchronicity assumptions; `latest`: The most recent block in the canonical chain observed by the client, this block may be re-orged out of the canonical chain even under healthy/normal conditions; `pending`: A sample next block built by the client on top of `latest` and containing the set of transactions usually taken from local mempool. If the `safe` or `finalized` tag cannot be resolved to a block, the method responds as it does for an unknown block.
oneOf.title: Block tag

items.description: Preorder traversal. traceAddress gives child ordinals and subtraces counts direct children. Localization fields are required on historical records; null transaction fields are allowed only for protocol reward records. Simulation records omit localization. Failed frames require error and result, retaining revert bytes and measured gas when available, otherwise result is null. Stable error-kind vocabulary is an open decision (H05,H09,H10,H24).

methods.summary: Returns localized call traces for a block.

methods.description: Execute against the state at the end of the selected block, default latest, preserving its fork rules and block environment. Explicit zero fees are permitted without rewriting BASEFEE. Simulated changes are discarded. EVM failure is trace output; invalid parameters or unavailable state are RPC errors (H08,H11,H15,H28). This is a provisional trace profile; see docs-api/docs/trace-profile.md and its H01-H28 decision references.

schema.description: Unsigned simulation. Omitted or null to creates a contract. Defaults: from zero address, value zero, input empty, nonce from selected state, fees zero. Omitted gas uses the client execution cap. data is a compatibility alias for input; when both are present they MUST agree. Legacy gasPrice and dynamic fee fields MUST NOT be combined. Blob and authorization overrides remain outside this first profile.

items.title: Flat call trace record

anyOf.description: code is the actually executed bytecode, including initcode and resolved delegated code. ex records same-step effects; used is gas remaining after the operation. push contains replacement stack suffix words as minimal quantities; mem contains bytes written at off; store records the storage write. sub recursively describes the child execution caused by this opcode. op and idx are optional annotations. Exact nested-call stipend/refund accounting and failed-op ex conventions remain provisional (H19-H21).

methods.summary: Executes an unsigned call and returns selected traces.

methods.description: Each [call, traceTypes] pair executes against the preceding simulated post-state. Reverted writes roll back; subsequent calls continue. Return one envelope per input in order. The sequence never changes canonical state. Empty input returns [] (H15,H16). This is a provisional trace profile; see docs-api/docs/trace-profile.md and its H01-H28 decision references.

methods.summary: Executes dependent unsigned calls in order.

methods.description: Apply OR within each address list and AND between the lists; omitted/empty lists are unrestricted. Match CALL sender/recipient, CREATE creator/created address, SELFDESTRUCT destroyed account/refund beneficiary. Failed CREATE has no created-address match. Reward author matches toAddress and has no fromAddress. Sort by block, transaction, preorder, then rewards; paginate after matching. Capture one canonical snapshot for the request and error if required history is unavailable (H03-H06,H23,H27). This is a provisional trace profile; see docs-api/docs/trace-profile.md and its H01-H28 decision references.

methods.name: trace_filter

schema.description: Inclusive block range; defaults fromBlock earliest, toBlock latest, after 0, count unlimited subject to an explicit server limit. OR within each address list; AND between lists. Missing or empty lists are unrestricted; null is invalid. mode is outside this baseline. Resolve tags once per request. Apply filtering before pagination; count 0 returns []. Return an error rather than silently truncate when a server limit is exceeded (H03,H04,H23,H27).

methods.description: Decode and validate the signed transaction, including chain identity, nonce, funds and intrinsic gas. Preserve its signed fields; do not replace the nonce. The baseline has exactly two parameters. A block-selector extension requires separate agreement. Validation failure returns a complete JSON-RPC error, not a partially serialized result (H12-H14,H25).
